title: Weekly Cash Burn Rate
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=firefly:txn
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(amount<0,abs(amount),0))) as outflow, sum(eval(if(amount>0,amount,0))) as inflow by _time
| eval burn=round(outflow-inflow,2)
| where burn>0
| sort - burn
description: Calculates each week's net cash burn so you can tell the difference between an expensive week and a structurally unsustainable one.
value: Personal finance dashboards are most helpful when they reveal pace, not just totals; burn rate turns random transactions into a momentum metric.
implementation: Forward categorized income and expense transactions to Splunk; review weekly burn and compare it to expected seasonal spikes.
visualization: Weekly bar chart of inflow, outflow, and net burn.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how much cash you are really burning through each week after money in and money out are compared.
